purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of volcanic-hazard sources relevant to catastrophe risk, event validation and secondary atmospheric impacts.

entries.name: WOVOdat Database of Volcanic Unrest v2
entries.provider: World Organization of Volcano Observatories / IAVCEI, hosted by Earth Observatory of Singapore
entries.spatial_scope: global contributions from volcano observatories and research institutions
entries.temporal_scope: event- and station-dependent historical and modern unrest records
entries.resolution_or_granularity: station, network and episode data organized by measured parameters under the WOVOdat 2.0 schema
entries.note: Coverage and measurement semantics are heterogeneous across observatories, stations and episodes. WOVOdat's published policy attributes ownership to original contributors, restricts redistribution and frames free use around crisis response, education and research; this candidate therefore requires especially careful rights review before any commercial or redistributed use.

entries.name: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Level-2 Sulfur Dioxide
entries.temporal_scope: April 2018-present for the non-time-critical Level-2 archive
entries.resolution_or_granularity: orbit/granule-based Level-2 total-column SO2 retrievals with product-version-dependent pixel geometry, quality fields and processing
entries.note: SO2 is a retrieved atmospheric column rather than a direct ash or damage observation, and non-volcanic sources also contribute. Processor and collection changes are scientifically material: the mission-wide SO2 reprocessing completed in 2025 superseded older products for much of the archive, so exact product class, collection, processor version and quality filtering must be frozen before comparison.

entries.name: NCEI/WDS Global Significant Volcanic Eruptions Database
entries.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information / World Data Service
entries.resolution_or_granularity: eruption-event records with hazard, location, VEI and available socio-economic impact attributes
entries.note: This is deliberately a significance-selected impact catalogue, not a complete eruption-frequency catalogue. Inclusion criteria favor fatalities, damage, VEI 6+ events and eruptions associated with tsunamis or significant earthquakes, so sampling and reporting biases must be preserved when using it for model validation.
